response.overview: Life is a constant struggle of self-actualization through apathy. This is a story of two people a father and son  Who have totally different definition of love, constantly struggle to understand each other, after demise of the mother, who was a bridge between them, the silence tore them apart to the extent of mental and physical repercussions
response.tagline: Life is a constant struggle of self-actualization through apathy.
response.title: New Moon
